verdict.rationale: Workable documents a broad public REST API with scoped tokens covering jobs, candidates (list, create, rate), offers, stages, requisitions, members, departments, permission sets, events and webhook subscriptions. Probes confirm the docs are live and agent-readable via llms.txt and .md pages. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving workflows end-to-end through the API.
